(this “Agreement"), made as of the 5 day of December, 2012, by 1683 THIRD AVENUE ASSOCIATES LLC ("Associates"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1681 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10128,Attention: Neal A. Dunatov. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Associates is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 1683 Third Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Tax Lot 3 (also known as Future Tax Lots 3 and 9003) in Block 1540 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the "Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the“Owner Fee Parcel"); WHEREAS, Associates intends to subdivide the Owner Fee Parcel to create the Lower Parcel (as hereinafter defined) and the Airspace Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Associates, in its capacity as owner of a portion of Tax Lot 3 (in land which lies below the Lower Limiting Plane (as hereinafter defined), with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 1683 Third Avenue, New York, New York, currently designated as part of Tax Lot 3 in Block 1540 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Land," said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Lower Parcel"); WHEREAS, Associates, in its capacity as owner of a portion of Tax Lot 3 (in such capacity, sometimes referred to herein as“Developer") intends to convey that certain parcel of air space (the “Airspace Parcel") which lies above a horizontal plane (the “Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at a height of 120 feet above Datum Level (as hereinafter defined), currently Exhibit C annexed hereto and made a part hereof, by deed so that Lower Parcel Owner shall be the owner in fee of the Lower Parcel and another party shall be the owner in fee of the Airspace Parcel; WHEREAS, this Agreement is being entered into in order to obtain a tax lot numberfor theAirspaceParcel. 1 KL3 2904944.2
